facts.statement: The genus Santanadactylus was named by the Dutch paleontologist Paul de Buisonjé in 1980.
facts.quote: authority: De Buisonjé, 1980

facts.statement: Fossils of Santanadactylus have been found in the Albian-aged Romualdo Member of the Santana Formation in the Araripe Plateau, Brazil.
facts.quote: from the Albian-aged Romualdo Member of the Early Cretaceous Santana Formation, of Barra do Jardim, Araripe Plateau, Ceará State, Brazil

facts.statement: Santanadactylus is described as a rather large pterosaur.
facts.quote: It was a rather large pterosaur

facts.statement: The type species S. brasilensis is based on a partial right humerus and a right scapulacoracoid.
facts.quote: an upper part of the right humerus and a right scapulacoracoid

facts.statement: The species S. spixi was intermediate in size compared to the other species named by Wellnhofer.
facts.quote: S. spixi, intermediate in size

facts.statement: The preserved skull section of S. araripensis showed no crest.
facts.quote: the preserved skull section had no crest

facts.statement: Chris Bennett suggested that S. araripensis and S. pricei were pteranodontids.
facts.quote: S. araripensis and S. pricei were pteranodontids

facts.statement: Chris Bennett suggested that S. spixi was a dsungaripterid.
facts.quote: S. spixi was a dsungaripterid

facts.statement: Unwin (2003) proposed that S. spixi was a species of Tupuxuara.
facts.quote: Unwin (2003) proposed that "Santanadactylus" spixi was a species of Tupuxuara

facts.statement: Averianov (2014) considered S. spixi a nomen dubium likely synonymous with Tupuxuara longicristatus.
facts.quote: Averianov (2014) considered Santanadactylus spixi a nomen dubium probably synonymous with Tupuxuara longicristatus

facts.statement: De Buisonjé first assigned Santanadactylus to the family Criorhynchidae (also known as Ornithocheiridae).
facts.quote: De Buisonjé first assigned Santanadactylus to Criorhynchidae (=Ornithocheiridae)

facts.statement: Bennett (1989) assigned the holotype of S. brasilensis to the family Pteranodontidae.
facts.quote: Bennett (1989) assigned S. brasilensis (holotype only) to Pteranodontidae

facts.statement: Wellnhofer indicated that the wingspan of various Santanadactylus species ranged from 2.9 to 5.7 meters.
facts.quote: Wellnhofer for the various species indicating a wingspan of 2.9 – 5.7 m

facts.statement: De Buisonjé estimated the wingspan of S. brasilensis to be 6 meters.
facts.quote: De Buisonjé thought Santanadactylus brasilensis had a wingspan of 6 m

facts.statement: Santanadactylus may have been adapted for gliding rather than flapping flight.
facts.quote: It may have been adapted for gliding over flapping flight

facts.statement: It is debated whether the four named species of Santanadactylus belong to the same genus.
facts.quote: Four species have been named, but today are not considered congeneric with each other

facts.statement: Thomas and McDavid (2025) suggested that the paratype RGM.631745 cannot be confidently referred to Santanadactylus because it belongs to Azhdarchomorpha.
facts.quote: Thomas and McDavid recovered the paratype RGM.631745 within Azhdarchomorpha in 2025, suggesting that specimen cannot be confidently referred to Santanadactylus

facts.statement: Recent studies consider S. araripensis a dubious species.
facts.quote: Recent study, however, considers S. araripensis dubious

facts.statement: The genus Santanadactylus was named in 1980 by the Dutch paleontologist Paul de Buisonjé.
facts.quote: El género fue nombrado en 1980 por el paleontólogo holandés Paul de Buisonjé.

facts.statement: The type species is S. brasilensis, a name referring to Brazil.
facts.quote: La especie tipo es S. brasilensis, y el nombre de la especie se refiere a Brasil.

facts.statement: The holotype UvA M 4894 consists of the upper right humerus, right scapula, and coracoid, housed at the Geological Institute of the University of Amsterdam.
facts.quote: Está basado en el holotipo UvA M 4894 (Instituto Geológico de la Universidad de Ámsterdam), una parte superior del húmero derecho y la escápula derecha y el coracoides

facts.statement: In 1985, German paleontologist Peter Wellnhofer named three additional species: S. araripensis, S. pricei, and S. spixi.
facts.quote: En 1985, Peter Wellnhofer, un paleontólogo alemán que ha escrito numerosas publicaciones científicas sobre pterosaurios, nombró tres especies adicionales: S. araripensis, S. pricei y S. spixi.

facts.statement: S. araripensis, named after the Araripe Plateau, is a large species based on specimen BSP 1982 I 89, which includes a partial skull (the ends of the jaws) and arms.
facts.quote: S. araripensis, nombrado por la meseta de Araripe, fue una especie grande basada en el ejemplar BSP 1982 I 89, cuyos restos incluyen un cráneo parcial (son el final de las mandíbulas) y los brazos

facts.statement: S. pricei, named after Llewellyn Ivor Price, was the smallest of the three species.
facts.quote: S. pricei, nombrado por Llewellyn Ivor Price, fue la menor de las tres especies

facts.statement: S. spixi, of intermediate size, is based on specimen BSP 1980 I 121, a left wing, and its name honors Johann Baptist von Spix.
facts.quote: S. spixi, intermedio en tamaño, está basado en BSP 1980 I 121, otra ala izquierda, cuyo nombre honra a Johann Baptist von Spix.

facts.statement: Chris Bennett suggested that S. brasilensis was a chimera of a pteranodontid and something else, while S. araripensis and S. pricei were pteranodontids and S. spixi was a dsungaripterid.
facts.quote: Chris Bennett sugirió que S. brasilensis era una quimera de un pteranodóntido y algo más (es decir, el holotipo y el paratipo pertenecían a formas diferentes), S. araripensis y S. pricei eran pteranodóntidos, y S. spixi era un dsungariptérido.

facts.statement: Wellnhofer removed S. spixi from the genus in 1991.
facts.quote: Wellnhofer también removió a S. spixi del género, en 1991.

facts.statement: Kellner concluded he found a single autapomorphy for S. brasilensis, the right ventral margin of the proximal part of the deltopectoral crest, which initially allowed only classification as an incertae sedis Pterodactyloidae but was restricted to Pteranodontoidea in 2000.
facts.quote: Kellner, por su parte concluyó que él pudo hallar una única autapomorfia para Santanadactylus brasilensis, el margen ventral derecho de la parte proximal de la cresta deltopectoral, que al principio no permitía más precisión que ser un Pterodactyloidae incertae sedis, pero en 2000 lo restringió a un Pteranodontoidea sensu Kellner.

facts.statement: De Buisonjé first placed the genus in the Criorhynchidae, a concept that is no longer used.
facts.quote: De Buisonjé primero situó al género en los Criorhynchidae, un concepto que ya no es usado.

facts.statement: Wellnhofer considered it a member of the Ornithocheiridae.
facts.quote: Wellnhofer lo consideró un miembro de los Ornithocheiridae.

facts.statement: According to Bennett, S. brasilensis belonged to the Pteranodontidae sensu Bennett.
facts.quote: De acuerdo a Bennett S. brasilensis pertenecía a los Pteranodontidae sensu Bennett.

facts.statement: According to Kellner, S. pricei belonged to a clade descending from the last common ancestor of Istiodactylus and the Anhangueridae.
facts.quote: S. pricei de acuerdo a Kellner perteneció a un clado descendiendo del último ancestro común de Istiodactylus y los Anhangueridae.

facts.statement: The parent group of Santanadactylus is Pteranodontidae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Pteranodontidae

facts.statement: The family of Santanadactylus is Pteranodontidae.
facts.quote: Family: Pteranodontidae

facts.statement: Santanadactylus is classified in the class Reptilia.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia

facts.statement: Santanadactylus lived during the Aptian stage, from 119.57 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (119.57 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Santanadactylus is considered a large pterosaur, with Peter Wellnhofer indicating a wingspan between 2.9 and 5.7 meters for the various species.
facts.quote: Santanadactylus es considerado como un pterosaurio grande, y para Wellnhofer indica que para las varias especies la envergadura estaba entre 2.9 a 5.7 metros.

facts.statement: Paul de Buisonjé believed S. brasilensis had a wingspan of six meters.
facts.quote: De Buisonjé piensa que Santanadactylus brasilensis tenía una envergadura de seis metros.

facts.statement: It may have been adapted for soaring flight rather than just flapping.
facts.quote: Puede haber estado adaptado para un vuelo de planeo en vez de sólo aletear.
